protocol.candidateGenerationAudit: Record which of the frozen twelve are produced by the production candidate generator under these parameters and baseline. Inclusion is descriptive and does not establish the causal effect of candidate generation.
comparisons: Best final score, with full harm weight
Exact production non-dominated set over cut-through reduction, adjusted harm, and intervention count

Screening simulation count and elapsed time

confirmation.claims: Confirmation tests the primary core-score winners and strongest missed package only. Other objectives, non-dominated-set coverage, and full finite-space optimality remain screening-only findings.
confirmation.selection: Before reading confirmation results, freeze the union of: (1) the valid package with highest final core score among beam-visited packages; (2) the valid package with highest final core score in the exhaustive set; (3) the valid nonempty package with highest final core score that the beam missed, if any. Break score ties lexicographically by frozen manifest-index vectors; deduplicate. The empty baseline, score zero, is eligible for (1) and (2) and is always run as the comparator. At most three nonempty packages plus baseline. No reselection on confirmation seeds.

protocol.order: Run production beam on a fresh state; freeze its visited sets and finalists; then fill missing exhaustive combinations. Never give the beam unseen exhaustive scores.
protocol.scope: Exact only within these twelve candidates, packages of at most three interventions, and the fixed screening objective and inputs. Confirmation estimates concern the frozen representatives, not an exhaustive full-hour optimum.
protocol.uncertainty: Seed intervals describe within-model randomness; comparisons across algorithm choice or model assumptions are separate. No claim of calibrated real-world effects.

manifest.selectionRule: Six named local junctions around Colby/North and its Dana and Hillegass bypasses; whole-node filters at all six, all four restriction variants at Hillegass/63rd, and Slow Streets on Colby, Dana and Hillegass. The two Colby/63rd T-junctions are separate sites. Selection used geometry and legal intervention types, not scenario scores.

metadata.scope: restricted candidate combinator benchmark on full network; not global optimum or real-world validation
